## Description

Trains score-based generative diffusion models on multi-asset macroeconomic and pricing panels to synthesize infinite joint distribution scenario paths for institutional portfolio stress testing.

## Where it may fit

Institutional stress testing, tail-risk scenario generation, multi-asset risk management under extreme market crashes.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Risk Management Groups, Institutional Pension Funds, Global Macro Funds.

## Required data

Multivariate historical asset return series, macroeconomic indicator panels, volatility surface histories.

## Caveats

Reverse diffusion sampling requires numerical ODE solvers, increasing scenario generation computation time.
